source: SFDR 2.0 proposal COM(2025) 841 (20 Nov 2025); PB Intelligence Dossier §1.4. Trilogue expected early Q4 2026; text NOT final. All values below are draft/proposal-stage and subject to change through trilogue.

portfolioPositiveContributionPercent.source: SFDR 2.0 proposal — general 70% portfolio positive-contribution threshold (sovereigns broadly excluded from the 70% test).
portfolioPositiveContributionPercent.notes: Trilogue battleground (4): thresholds/safe harbours including the 70% test. Sovereign exclusion scope also unsettled. This is a fund-level threshold surfaced by the engine as a fund-manager-facing note — never a pass/fail on the asset.

taxonomySafeHarbourPercent.source: SFDR 2.0 proposal — Commission baseline: 15% EU Taxonomy alignment auto-qualifies (safe harbour).
taxonomySafeHarbourPercent.notes: Trilogue battleground (4): Parliament wants this raised to 20% and the CTB/PAB benchmark safe harbour removed. Named contested item #1.

esgBasicsBottomScreenPercent.source: SFDR 2.0 proposal — Parliament position: ESG Basics claim requires screening out at least the bottom 20% of rated securities before an ESG-outperformance claim.
esgBasicsBottomScreenPercent.notes: Parliament-only position; Council/Commission have no equivalent screen. Applied to the ESG Basics category only.

mandatoryPaiCount.source: SFDR 2.0 proposal — Council position: >=3 mandatory PAI indicators from a forthcoming Commission list (+ a 4th adverse-impact indicator TBD).
mandatoryPaiCount.notes: Trilogue battleground (3): PAI regime voluntary (some) vs min-3 (Council) vs fully-mandatory with comply-or-explain (Parliament). Named contested item #2. Indicator list itself arrives via delegated acts 2027-28.

categoryExclusionScope.source: SFDR 2.0 proposal — each category carries category-specific exclusions; scope (esp. fossil-fuel exposure in Transition) is unsettled.
categoryExclusionScope.notes: Trilogue battleground (1): fossil-fuel exposure in the Transition category (Council supports a capex-based approach to including fossil-exposed issuers). Named contested item #3 (category exclusion scope). The exclusion LISTS below are draft.

paiIndicators.source: SFDR 2.0 forthcoming Commission PAI list (delegated acts 2027-28). This is PB's DC-material working set mapped onto SFDR L2 (2022/1288 Annex I Table 1) indicators until the 2.0 list is published.

sustainable.label: Sustainable (new Art. 9)
sustainable.description: Products contributing to sustainability goals via investments already meeting high standards. Asset-level: can a product in this category fund this asset?

transition.label: Transition (new Art. 7)
transition.description: Products channelling capital to companies/projects not yet sustainable but on a credible transition path. Asset-level: can a Transition product fund this asset while it improves?

esg_basics.label: ESG Basics (new Art. 8)
esg_basics.description: ESG integration beyond risk management, without a transition or sustainability objective. Asset-level: can an ESG Basics product fund this asset?
